articles.title: New DeFi entrant widens field of crypto political campaign funds as elections loom
articles.snippet: The Defend Developers PAC is aiming to contribute to lawmakers who seek to shield crypto developers from legal vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Banks' survey says people don't want to rock the boat if stablecoin yield risks lending
articles.snippet: The American Bankers Association, which lobbies against the crypto sector over the Clarity Act's stablecoin section, unveiled its new polling.

articles.title: New York and EU’s finance watchdogs team up to police stablecoins
articles.snippet: Some of the information that New York and the European Union’s watchdogs will share includes the issued stablecoins, total volume in circulation and the number of holders.

articles.title: Crypto PACs pour $3M into Maryland races as California voters head to polls
articles.snippet: An affiliate of a political action committee backed by crypto companies ramped up spending on ads in California ahead of Tuesday’s primaries, but still has millions of dollars at stake in Maryland later this month.

articles.title: New York’s Crypto Watchdog Teams With EU to Police Stablecoins
articles.snippet: The New York Department of Financial Services and European Banking Authority said they'll work together to oversee stablecoins.
